offering_description.value: Crane NXT designs and manufactures payment and cash-handling equipment for equipment makers, retailers, and gaming operators. It prints banknotes and develops security features for central banks, and supplies authentication, inspection, and traceability systems to governments and manufacturers.

primary_products.value: cash-handling equipment; electronic payment modules; banknotes and banknote security features; authentication labels and tax stamps; inspection systems and traceability software

primary_services.value: equipment installation and maintenance; cash-handling system integration; product authentication and traceability implementation

customer_segment.value: B2B: Payment equipment makers, retailers, vending and gaming operators, consumer goods companies, and pharmaceutical manufacturers; B2G: Central banks, government currency printers, tax authorities, and other government agencies

end_markets.value: retail and unattended commerce; gaming; currency issuance; consumer goods; pharmaceuticals

revenue_model.value: product sales: Payment hardware, cash-processing equipment, authentication labels, and inspection equipment; project or contract: Banknote production, government tax stamp programs, and system deployments; service fees: Equipment installation, maintenance, and field service; licensing or royalties: Authentication and traceability software licenses
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Makes payment and inspection equipment, banknotes, and security labels for operators, manufacturers, and governments; component supplier: Supplies payment modules to equipment makers and security features to banknote printers; service provider: Installs and maintains cash-handling systems for equipment operators; software / platform: Provides tools for governments and manufacturers to verify products and track them through supply chains
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Payment equipment, currency security, product authentication, and inspection and traceability systems

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Equipment makers, commercial operators, central banks, and government procurement programs; distributors / dealers: Payment equipment distributors and dealers; partners / resellers: Equipment integrators and banknote printers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Central bank procurement and security requirements, gaming equipment certification, and payment security standards

notes: Antares Vision’s current consolidation status is uncertain, so the inspection and traceability coverage is provisional.
